description: Live shipping prices for a parcel sent FROM Australia to another country, from Australia Post retail (PAC) and, where it can quote, Easyship's commercial panel. Returns each service with price and currency. Use when asked what it costs to post something overseas from Australia. Note that AusPost international prices are retail and exclude any destination duty or tax, which the recipient pays.

category.description: Optional goods category for Easyship. One of: accessory_no_battery, accessory_with_battery, audio_video, bags_luggages, books_collectibles, cameras, computers_laptops, documents, dry_food_supplements, fashion, health_beauty, home_appliances, home_decor, jewelry, mobile_phones, pet_accessory, sport_leisure, tablets, toys, watches. Defaults to 'fashion'.

from_postcode.description: Optional origin Australian postcode, used for the Easyship leg. Defaults to '3000'.

hs_code.description: Optional HS tariff code. More specific than category and matters for destination duty. Supplying this overrides category.

to_city.description: Optional destination city. Some couriers will not quote without it.

to_postcode.description: Optional destination postal code. Improves commercial-panel accuracy; ignored by AusPost.

to_state.description: Optional destination state or province code.

value_aud.description: Optional declared customs value in AUD. Defaults to 100.

weight_kg.description: Parcel weight in kilograms. AusPost caps international parcels at 20kg.

name: quote_international_from_au
title: Quote a parcel sent from Australia overseas
